name: @earendil-works/pi-client
description: Terminal client for the pi coding agent: talks to a pi server over HTTP and SSE

scripts.build:unbundled: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js && bun run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: bun run build:unbundled && bun src/cli.ts self-install --build-only --no-workspace-build --dir dist/binary
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/assets && shx cp src/assets/*.png dist/assets/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build

author: Earendil Works
